# TongueSync AI

> TongueSync AI turns one video into vertical shorts with animated captions and dubs them into local dialects (Arabic, Spanish, French, Hindi and more) with culturally-aware AI.

TongueSync AI is a web app for creators, agencies, and brand teams who want to reach global audiences without reshooting. The Clipper picks viral moments from long videos and renders vertical shorts with dynamic captions. The Dubbing pipeline translates and re-voices those shorts in 40+ regional accents. An AI Coach helps script and improve short-form ideas.
